correctness.rationale: Exact two-dimensional matrix exponential gives both terminal concentrations. Strict Feynman–Kac convexity gives global uniqueness; monotonic hyperbolic endpoint derivative gives the unique activation time; strict sinh(u)/u monotonicity gives a unique equal split for the other room; a justified large-time interior expansion gives the 1/t imbalance. A supplied checker passed 154010 finite supplementary assertions, not treated as a proof.

value.rationale: The claim gives a genuine all-rate boundary between concentrating and distributing purification capacity, a unique switching time and asymptotic allocation, alongside a distinct universal remote-room objective. It exposes that where one measures contamination changes the optimal allocation. The fact is interpretable as a controlled baseline for mixing-vs-cleaning design, without pretending to field-calibrated advice.
